get.summary: Search Contacts, scopes [DNS_SUPERADMIN_WRITE]
get.description:
Search contacts based on search string.

If search string contains only digits we try to fully match on CRN (company registration number).
Registry should store CRNs without leading zeros so we also strip them for CRN search.
For contact suggest the original query is preserved.

post.description:
Endpoint for creating long-term m2m API access tokens.

Inside token_request, we expect exactly one security scope. Either DNS_TOKEN_READ
or DNS_TOKEN_WRITE. The endpoint then performs scope expansion on token_request.scope.

The newly minted token has access only to domains whose domain IDs are stored inside
the managed_domain_ids attribute. If managed_domain_ids is set to ["*"] then the token has
access to all domains with matching contact_id.

400.description: None of the provided domain IDs can be managed.

409.description: API token with the given name already exists within the organization.
